This [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the former '''master''' of [[Maddie Macatten]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]. Operating as both a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]], he maintained premises on [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], including a docking bay which held the [[Gymsnor-2 light freighter]] ''[[Scupper Bantoo]]''.

While on a trading junket, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] ship, a vessel belonging to a mysterious alien race that held a deep hatred of slavers. Upon his death, Macatten found herself free and left Kal'Shebbol with the ''Scupper Bantoo''.
